cards.name: Lair of the Hydra
cards.oracleText:
If you control two or more other lands, this land enters tapped.
{T}: Add {G}.
{X}{G}: Until end of turn, this land becomes an X/X green Hydra creature. It's still a land. X can't be 0.

cards.name: Lairwatch Giant
cards.oracleText:
This creature can block an additional creature each combat.
Whenever this creature blocks two or more creatures, it gains first strike until end of turn.

cards.name: Lair Delve
cards.oracleText: Reveal the top two cards of your library. Put all creature and land cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

cards.name: Lair of the Ashen Idol
cards.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature. If you can't, planeswalk.
Whenever chaos ensues, any number of target players each create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
